exposure: induction of labor with Dinoprostone gel (PGE2)
outcome: fetal and maternal morbidity and mortality
cohort: 100 primigravidas with singleton pregnancy beyond 35 weeks of gestation and with Bishop score of less than 5 (cases) and 100 controls
finding: Dinoprostone gel is effective in improving Bishop score, but it is also associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women.
